rule: An image is hosted only when the work is public domain (artist died before 1956, faithful 2-D reproduction) AND its Wikimedia Commons file page states Public domain / pd (read from the Commons API on the date above). Everything else is a framed title card. Originals are not kept in the repository: each file is the Commons image downscaled to 512 px on its long side and re-encoded as JPEG (quality 68).
